o-mne.title: About me
o-mne.subtitle: I'm a photographer based in Prague.
o-mne.bio: I shoot portraits, weddings and larps. I like capturing things as they actually happened — no over-posing in front of the lens. I travel across the Czech Republic but my home base is Prague.
